condition: When dayjs.tz(input, zone) gets a Date or a timestamp instead of a string, it keeps the same instant and doesn't read the input as wall-clock time in that zone. A string input with the same value is read as zone time, so the two give different results.
workaround: Pass a string (for example a local datetime string without an offset) to dayjs.tz when you want it read as wall-clock time in the target zone. To convert an instant, use dayjs(date).tz(zone).
